summary: Implemented open and wrap_file for rich.progress as specified. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _Reader and _ReaderContext, private _make_reader_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (13 new tests); docs/source/progress.rst (two new sections); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added entry). Diff is additive only, nothing committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run, per instructions. Unverified risks: subclassing io.RawIOBase with typing.BinaryIO, and some lines over 88 characters in docstrings and messages. Choices to review: a broad str-mode overload on Progress.open, readinto implemented via read, a private helper, a missing file raising ValueError instead of FileNotFoundError, and the task being added before the file is opened.
